archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-contract
archetypes.rationale: Parser-facing prompt grammar must remain exact after prose compression.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed prompt-rendering code and tests for any drift in voter grammar, section anchors, and NO_ISSUES_FOUND contracts. Check that the compressed wording still preserves default-deny voting thresholds and that tests assert exact parser-facing strings rather than new prose snapshots. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
